name: smwmusic-mega-man-x3-maverick-hunters-strike-back-opening-stage-genso-mix
title: Mega Man X3 - Maverick Hunters Strike Back ~ Opening Stage (Genso-Mix)
description:
Did an extended arrangement of the Opening Stage from Mega Man X3. Just felt like doing a remix of a nostalgic theme (at least for me). I love X3's OST, despite its obvious shortcomings (especially the SNES version). It has that intense energy that the series is most known for, and the compositions are really great!!!

Added the Eastern Story melody 'cuz "haha funny Touhou reference" and thought it'd be sick to have a Touhou reference in one of my X series remixes.


Important:
♠ "Bonus End," & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. G Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. F# Minor (Custom Pitch)
